nd57b8e9833.headline: Zambia : ZICA Appeals For A Reduction On PAYE Tax
nd57b8e9833.summary: The Zambia Institute of Chartered Accountants has appealed to the Ministry of Finance for a reduction in Pay-As-You-Earn tax as part of 2018 budget proposals.
nd57b8e9833.why: Tax policy changes can influence disposable income, consumer spending, and overall economic growth.

n68a0735bae.headline: Fabricato restarted its machines
n68a0735bae.summary: Fabricato resumed operations after a two-week shutdown, having saved $5 billion, and is promoting its Made in Colombia campaign.
n68a0735bae.why: Fabricato is a notable player in Colombia's textile industry; its restart signals recovery in local manufacturing and potential positive effects on employment and exports.
